title: kate-core: return the fold range at an offset
summary: View::folded_range_at returns the shortest stored range that contains the offset. The end offset is outside. The test goes in the existing view tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: view.rs has one test module named tests. Add the new function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Leave fold.rs unchanged. Add folded_range_at on View. Look at self.folds. Keep ranges whose contains method returns true for at. Return the shortest of those ranges. When two ranges have the same length, return the one with the later start. Return None when no range contains at. The test folded_range_at_picks_the_shortest builds a view the same way as the_header_text_is_outside_the_fold. apply_indent_folds of a, newline, two spaces, b, newline, and tab width 4 stores 1..6. Offset 0 returns None. Offset 1 and offset 5 return 1..6. Offset 6 returns None. Then assign folds to 0..10 and 2..5. Offset 3 returns 2..5. Offset 1 returns 0..10. Offset 10 returns None. Then assign folds to 0..4 and 1..5. Offset 2 returns 1..5. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: view::tests::folded_range_at_picks_the_shortest
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because folded_range_at does not exist. For a, newline, two spaces, b, newline, offset 0 and offset 6 return None. Offsets 1 and 5 return 1..6. With ranges 0..10 and 2..5, offset 3 returns 2..5 and offset 1 returns 0..10. With ranges 0..4 and 1..5, offset 2 returns 1..5.
